blocks.x: There’s still time to book a beachfront escape for this fall with Iberostar’s best deals. Known for its all-inclusive luxury, focus on sustainability, and prime seaside locations, Iberostar offers a range of stays from stylish adults-only retreats to family-friendly resorts where (given some minimal credentials), the kids you travel with stay for free.

As a family-owned Spanish hotel group with a legacy dating back to 1956, Iberostar stands out for its commitment to responsible tourism, ocean conservation, and creating unforgettable stays. Right now, travelers can save up to 30% on stays, score extra discounts on last-minute bookings, or plan ahead for additional savings at top Caribbean and Brazilian properties. Plus, IHG One Rewards members earn points on stays—and the Iberostar app makes managing your trip effortless, from booking activities to requesting services. Whether it’s a spontaneous getaway or a well-planned retreat, here’s how to snag a discount.
Book a fall getaway with Iberostar for up to 60% off (without a coupon)

If you’re planning to finish off 2026 in style, take advantage of some notable Iberostar offers across the globe. In Miami, for one, you can save up to 35% on a sun-soaked stay in South Beach—making the region ever more tempting. Caribbean travelers can save up to 60% at Iberostar Selection Riviera Cancun, up to 40% at Iberostar Waves Costa Dorada in the Dominican Republic, and up to 20% off at the brand’s top-rated Joia Aruba by Iberostar.
More Iberostar coupons: extra 10% off rates when you pre-pay or book early

When making an early booking, travelers booking through Iberostar can use the Prepaid Rates function to score an extra 10% off of hotels in Spain, Morocco, Tunisia, Greece, Portugal, and Montenegro. Discounts can be combined with other offers on select hotels (while there are some conditions for combining discounts, you will be notified of such in your checkout process). Do note that with the prepaid rate discount, cancellations are not permitted.

In addition to this core offer, prepaid rates can deliver up to 40% off select hotels in the destinations listed above, as well as properties in the Caribbean, Miami, and Brazil. For Europe and Africa, travelers booking directly on Iberostar's website can save up to 25% by selecting the prepaid rate, or up to 15% with a flexible rate. Separately, Iberostar’s early-booking discount offers an extra 10% off reservations made more than 91 days in advance, valid for stays through October 31, 2026, across destinations including Aruba, Brazil, the Dominican Republic, Jamaica, Mexico, and the US.
Take 50% off at Iberostar Selection Zanzibar with its opening offer

A new Zanzibar stay is calling. To celebrate the opening of Iberostar Selection Zanzibar, travelers can save up to 50% on an all-inclusive stay when booking the prepaid rate directly through Iberostar. Set along the crystal-clear waters of Muyuni Beach, the new resort makes a particularly enticing escape for anyone already dreaming about a beach break this fall.

The opening offer is available for bookings made from now through September 30, for stays from November 1 through April 30, 2027. The discount is already applied to the prepaid rate, so there’s no promo code to enter. Iberostar also promises its best online price guarantee when you book through its website or contact center. Just note that the opening offer can't be combined with other promotions, and prepaid rates are subject to their applicable terms. For the latest availability and booking details, you can read all about it on its Iberostar Selection Zanzibar site listing.

Enjoy top deals in our favorite destinations

While you may have already heard of Iberostar Grand Hotel Paraiso in Playa del Carmen, Mexico, or Iberostar Playa Mita, the brand’s properties extend across the Caribbean, Brazil, Miami Beach, and beyond. Travelers can expect top-tier hospitality, world-class dining, some all-inclusive options, and exceptional service at Iberostar sites.

Whether you're planning a romantic retreat or a family adventure, Iberostar offers unbeatable deals on some of the most stunning beachfront resorts. Enjoy all-inclusive luxury, world-class golf courses, and rejuvenating spa experiences while saving on top destinations, including Iberostar Cancun (a true and idyllic family-friendly resort), Iberostar Cozumel (with a diving center and boats to explore the second-largest coral reef in the world), Iberostar Grand Bávaro (which includes free airport transfers, resort credits, and all-inclusive packages), Iberostar Riviera Maya (spanning seven different resorts in the region), and Iberostar Jamaica (with three hotels alongside Montego Bay).
Get Iberostar hotel discounts and exclusive perks with IHG Rewards

Join IHG One Rewards to start earning points during your next stay at participating Iberostar Hotels and Resorts, as well as over 6,000 IHG hotels and resort destinations worldwide. Membership includes access to special rates and offers as well as late checkout. IHG One Rewards Elite members receive even more benefits, including additional bonus points, welcome amenities, and Milestone Rewards.

You can also check out the Iberostar Club Membership, or The Club, which is under a different domain and does not appear to give access to any of these exclusive deals. Instead, it allows members access to elevated spa and wellness treatments, an array of exclusive accommodations, and more personalized services upon request.
How to fix an Iberostar promo code that’s not working

If your Iberostar promo code doesn't happen to work at checkout, not to worry—there are some tips and tricks that might help. For starters, double check that your code is spelled correctly and that there are no extra spaces or typos. If you haven't already, check the details of the promo code to ensure it's still active and hasn't expired. (Some discount codes might be offered only with a minimum spend requirement, so make sure your booking total meets any necessary criteria to qualify.)

If everything checks out and your Iberostar promo code still isn't working, clear your browser's cache and give the page a refresh. In any case, you can call or submit a message enquiry via Iberostar's customer service page.
